newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand sees economic recovery, lower rates.
newsitem.headline: Thailand sees economic recovery, lower rates.

text.p: Thailand's central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond said on Thursday that he saw the slowing nation economy recovering from the second quarter of 1997 and predicted lower interest rates in the new year.

He expected the economic recovery and lower rates to result from a substantial increase in liquidity that would hit the market from March next year as more public sector pension funds invested funds in the local market.
